tools.name: list_supplier_products
tools.when_to_use: Browse or page through supplier products the catalog has ingested; optionally filter by supplier code.
tools.when_not_to_use: Fetching one product you already have the id for (use get_supplier_product), or prices/availability (use the offer service).

tools.name: get_supplier_product
tools.when_to_use: Fetch a single supplier product by its internal supplier_product_id (ULID).
tools.when_not_to_use: Searching or listing without an id (use list_supplier_products).

tools.name: list_canonical_products
tools.when_to_use: Browse canonical (platform) product cards, or find the canonical product that aggregates a given GTIN-14.
tools.when_not_to_use: Fetching one card you already have the id for (use get_canonical_product), or free-text search (use the search service).

tools.name: get_canonical_product
tools.when_to_use: Fetch one canonical product card (merged title/brand/gtin/attributes plus member supplier_product_ids) by its ULID.
tools.when_not_to_use: Listing or GTIN lookup without an id (use list_canonical_products).
